comparisons.peer_summary: Guarantees include additional commitments from the American Airlines co-branded credit card partnership agreement executed in December 2024, as well as guarantees of subsidiaries. Citi believes maximum exposure figures are not representative of actual potential loss based on historical and expected future portfolio performance.
comparisons.comparison: Citigroup also entered into agreements regarding a co-branded credit card partnership in 2024, similar to Goldman Sachs' transition of its GM program, but focused on extending an existing American Airlines partnership rather than transitioning away. While Goldman Sachs is exiting its GM co-branded program by transitioning it to another issuer, Citigroup is amending its American Airlines co-branded credit card partnership agreement, noting that the maximum exposure figures for these guarantees are not representative of actual potential loss.
